name: Arkeologens Reise
notes: Cross-browser stability release. Removes the emergency start script that bypassed the prologue, repairs malformed Aurora DOM in Egypt/chamber/desert, uses single-path pointer/touch/mouse hold controls, adds keyboard controls, protects localStorage access, retries standards fullscreen without options, and keeps iPhone standalone guidance. Music falls back to Web Audio if mystisk_musikk.mp3 is not present.
